entities.name: Haazda

entities.name: League of Wojek
entities.description: The official lawmen whose areas the Haazda do not cover; better trained and armed.

entities.name: R.A.M.I.
entities.description: A detective agency compared with the Haazda Investigations.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which the Haazda founded a detective agency.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Haazda operate.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the Haazda found an independent detective agency in the same areas.
events.quote: the Haazda founded an independent detective agency

relations.note: The Haazda cover areas the official lawmen do not and are less trained.
relations.quote: covering areas that are not covered by League of Wojek
